sources: Flare 2.0 新动作清单 2026-11-20（Google 表 1njBhCNMs-iliNbt3gKxDwCZnpQBxQoi-yPFRGQHmJwk，P2 地面派克支撑）

purpose.zh: 练直臂顶肩，倒立和派克俯卧撑前的入门
purpose.en: Builds straight-arm overhead pushing; the entry step before handstands and pike push-ups.

text.zh: 手臂锁直往上顶肩，屁股是最高点
text.en: Arms locked, push tall, hips are the highest point

text.zh: 手与肩同宽撑地，脚往手的方向走近一点。
text.en: Hands shoulder-width; walk your feet in toward your hands.

text.zh: 耳朵在两臂之间，背别塌。
text.en: Ears between your arms, back flat.

text.zh: 腿后侧太紧可以微微屈膝。
text.en: If your hamstrings are tight, soften your knees a little.

commonErrors.zh: 耸肩缩脖子，没把地推开
commonErrors.en: Sinking into your shoulders instead of pushing the floor away.
Dropping your hips toward a plank.

cautions.en: Stop if your wrists or shoulders hurt.

flare2.plans: 1 个计划（阶段 11/15 初级，徒手）
flare2.camera: 正侧面（与脚垫高派克支撑同一机位）
flare2.doseBrief: 表内未给剂量；草稿按 3 组 × 20 秒、休 45 秒
flare2.note: Animation (r1): imported from t-elevated-pike-hold (same camera); feet on the mat, hip angle 69.7 deg, arms 5-9 deg off the trunk line, hips 32 cm above everything else, legs straight.

set.zh: 手臂锁直往上顶肩，屁股顶高
set.en: Arms locked, push tall, hips high
